description: Two decisions written into calls. A constant seed makes every run produce the same sequence; whether that sequence is used for something that must be unguessable is the separate question CWE-338 is declined over, and this rule claims only what the call says. A connection told not to check the hostname accepts any valid certificate rather than the one belonging to the host, which is a different failure from not checking validity at all. The signature case needs the algorithms option to be present, which is what tells a JWT `verify=False` apart from a TLS one -- the same keyword means two different things in two libraries.

expected.note: the same sequence on every run and on every machine
any valid certificate will do, not the right one
the verifier is told not to verify; the algorithms option is what distinguishes this from a TLS verify=False
